doc.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Jackie Cain's Time & Love
summary: Brown names a Jackie Cain CTI record; Laws barely remembers it.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: The next one that seems to loom large because of a lot of the personnel that were involved with it, some of the folks that you’ve always been – this is Jackie Cain, again on CTI, Time & Love. I don’t know if that’s a memorable . . .
No, I’m not – I don’t remember Jackie Cain. I vaguely remember that name. What did she do?
Day by Day, Time & Love, Summer Song, Summertime, Bachianas Brasileiras #5.
Um-hmm. Those are the tunes that were . . .
That was her record though, right?
